verdict.rationale: Appwrite's own Docker-based distribution runs the entire backend stack on any OS with a Docker CLI. Its CLI can target a self-hosted endpoint, Functions are marketed as "develop locally, deploy when ready," and one-click migration moves projects between self-hosted and Cloud. A community user also notes the containerized setup eases dev and testing. missing for 10: explicit first-party local-development workflow docs (the self-hosting docs frame it as infrastructure ownership rather than a local emulator), hands-on corroboration of a local-to-Cloud promotion flow.
